content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ABIOC(EDR-013 DLL Side-Loaded Module Loads from a User-Writable Path in a Signed Host Process) AND ABIOC(EDR-013 Unbacked Private-Heap Execution Reached via Locale or Window Enumeration Callback) observed on the same agent_hostname and causality_actor_process_image_name (the shared CGO / causality-actor join key both ABIOCs now surface, with actor_process_instance_id / causality_actor_process_instance_id pinning the exact process nodes) within a 10-minute window — fuses the side-loading delivery stage and the fileless enum-callback shellcode execution into a single UUID-string-staging intrusion incident anchored to the signed-host-binary causality chain (no VirtualAlloc RWX, no CreateThread, no cross-process injection to key on).
rules.name: UUID-String Shellcode Staging with Enum-Callback Execution — ABIOC Causality Stitch
